message: Interaction test fails: cabinet_1 front door hits other_3 while opening. Fix its hinge side, pivot, range or clearance so it can really be used.

Cabinet extends all the way to the north brick wall (x=1.4, z=-0.35, width=2.5 reaches z=-1.6), whereas in the footage it stops about 0.35 m short of the north wall, flush with the eastern edge of the window arch.
Upper cabinet stops about 0.35 m short of the north wall in the footage, but in the scene its 2.5 m width centered at z=-0.35 extends all the way to the north wall (z=-1.6).
Locker handles are oriented horizontally at the top center of each door, whereas in the footage they are vertical keypad locks located near the top-left of each locker door.
Cabinet door handles are oriented vertically in the render, whereas in the footage they are horizontal black bar handles near the top edge of the doors.
